goal_checks.notes: 4 profiles, one workspace (L leads, A and B members) and a sanity check that every check runs as authenticated as the right profile.
B sees 0 of A's private highlights; A sees their own (positive twin).
B sees 0 mini_conclusions of a private highlight; A sees it.
B cannot insert layer=group or insert as A; the leader can.

Private row routed to user:{A} only; promoted row reaches ws:{session}; B may listen on ws: and not user:{A}; an outsider cannot listen on ws:; A's other devices can listen on user:{A}. Killed by a leak mutation.
B's promote raises and changes nothing; A's one call flips highlight and note together; B then sees the promoted pair and still not the private one.
A removed from team_members cannot insert a highlight or a note.
B sees 0 of A's individual run and its four child tables; sees the group run; A sees their own.
B cannot insert a group run or a run owned by A; A can insert their own but not a group run; the leader can insert a group run.
Unsharing sends RETRACT on ws:{session}; the row update goes to user:{A}; B reads the RETRACT and no longer sees the row.
A group-visibility note on a private highlight is routed to user:{A} only and B cannot select it.
A private highlight's mini_conclusion goes to user:{A} only; a promoted one is re-fired to ws:{session}.
Second apply of 0004_lite.sql on the same database exits 0 (node test).

B cannot insert/update/delete children of a group run nor delete the run; a non-leader member cannot add; the owner can write and delete their own run; the leader can write and delete the group run. Killed by two mutations.
Members cannot write group or initial memory; the leader can write both; members read the minutes. Killed by a mutation.

Creator is the one leader; other workspaces are invisible; a non-leader and a former leader cannot transfer; a non-member target is refused; after a transfer exactly one leader; an unknown user cannot create a workspace. Killed by mutations.
